text: dsh-plugin-diraud 是面向 DSH Web 的插件来源审计与管理插件。它注册 /plugin-audit 命令，并在侧边栏底部提供插件目录面板，按官方、自装和内置来源分组显示已加载插件，支持关键词搜索与双语描述。用户可以查看自装插件状态、启用或停用插件、检查并更新插件，也可以确认后卸载自装插件；命令行支持按来源筛选及按关键词操作。适合需要辨别插件来源并管理 profile 中社区插件的 DSH Web 用户。安装后无需配置 API 密钥；更新检查会查询 npm registry，其他安装来源使用相应的 Git 查询逻辑。

dsh-plugin-diraud helps DSH Web users audit plugin origins. Its command and sidebar catalog group loaded plugins as official, self-installed, or built-in. Users can search, inspect status, toggle self-installed plugins, check and apply updates, and confirm uninstall. No API key is needed.
想查看当前 DSH 插件里哪些是官方提供、哪些是自己安装的。
有没有办法按插件来源整理列表，并能搜特定包名？
我想从 DSH 侧边栏打开插件目录，看看每个插件的启用状态。
如何在命令行里只列出官方插件或自装插件？
能不能在 DSH 里停用一个自己装的插件，并让设置重启后仍然生效？
我想检查社区插件有没有新版本，再从面板里更新。
How can I tell which loaded DSH plugins are official and which I installed?
Can I search a plugin catalog and manage updates for my self-installed DSH plugins?
dsh-plugin-diraud 的功能「插件来源审计」：/plugin-audit 命令读取已加载的 Loader 条目，按官方、自装和内置来源分组；可筛选官方或自装列表，也可用关键词搜索包名和条目。
dsh-plugin-diraud 的功能「插件目录与开关」：侧边栏底部的插件目录面板展示分组后的插件及状态；对自装插件可启用或停用，操作通过 remote 写入 profile patch 并即时更新 Loader。
dsh-plugin-diraud 的功能「自装插件更新和卸载」：插件目录可检查自装插件更新、选择更新，并在确认后卸载插件；更新检查按安装来源查询版本，面板提供进度和结果状态。
dsh-plugin-diraud 的更新检查会向 npm registry 查询自装包版本；更新或卸载操作在对应 profile 目录调用 pnpm 命令。

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH)
plugin-management enhancement: group the plugin list by source so you can tell
**official** plugins apart from the ones **you installed yourself** at a glance.

dsh-plugin-diraud README · Commands：| Command | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `/plugin-audit` | Overview: self-installed one-by-one + official count |
| `/plugin-audit user` | Self-installed only |
| `/plugin-audit official` | Official only (full list) |
| `/plugin-audit <keyword>` | Filter by package / entry keyword |
| `/plugin-audit disable <keyword>` | Disable a matching **self-installed** plugin (persisted) |
| `/plugin-audit enable <keyword>` | Enable a matching **self-installed** plugin (persisted) |
| `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-plugin-diraud` | Uninstall |

dsh-plugin-diraud README · Commands：> **How toggles persist**: `disable/enable` writes a `- id: <raw config id>` +
> `disabled: true` override into the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` (the user
> config layer). dsh watches that file (`watchUserPatches`), so the change
> applies live without a restart, survives restarts, and deleting the row
> restores the default.
>
> **Why the raw id (fixed in v0.4)**: loader entries carry a path-prefixed full
> id (`include:ssh`), but the patch layer matches each config row's own `id`
> field (`ssh`). Older versions wrote the prefixed id into the patch file, so
> the row was skipped at boot ("patch: entry not found") and the toggle was
> silently lost on restart. v0.4 writes the raw id, keeps the full id for
> `ctx.loader.update`, and cleans up legacy `include:<id>` rows.

dsh-plugin-diraud README · Configuration：Origin is derived from the package scope by default; edge cases (e.g. a
third-party package published under `@deepseek-ai/`) are overridden via
`extraUserPackages`. Override this plugin's row in the profile's
`cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- id: plugin-audit
  config:
    extraUserPackages:
      - '@deepseek-ai/dsh-my-fork'   # force-classify as self-installed

dsh-plugin-diraud README · Repository layout：```text
dsh-plugin-diraud/
  src/classify.ts        origin-classification pure function (single source of truth)
  src/patch.ts           cordis.patch.yml read/write (persist toggles)
  src/toggle.ts          shared toggle core (persist + ctx.loader.update)
